items.name: Nacken's Fiddle-String
items.lore: A single string of silver hair. Pluck it and someone, somewhere, starts to dance.

items.name: Black-Pool Ring
items.lore: Jet from the bottom of the nacken's pool. It is always faintly damp.

items.name: Fiddler's Bow-Bracer
items.lore: A strip of horsehair and pine, worn on the wrist the way Eilif wears his.

items.name: Dancing-Green Sash
items.lore: Green silk, the kind worn at midsummer dances.

items.name: Hild's Rune-Stave Charm
items.lore: A splinter of a gotawitch's stave, its blood-runes sanded off. One rune stayed. It means 'sorry'.

items.name: Seeress' Veil
items.lore: A grey veil, worn by the seers of Gotar when they read the threads.

items.name: Unbranded Bracer
items.lore: A plain leather bracer. Hild wears its twin, over the place a brand would have been.

items.name: Flayer's Hook-Ring
items.lore: A troll-flayer's ring, hooked like a skinning knife.
